chapter: Early bands, Calloway to Basie and Kansas City (third typescript)
title: His reputation as a heavy drinker
summary: He left and came back to bands because of drinking, and says a reputation as a drinker is hard to shake.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah, I'd get tired and come back. That's because I imbibed I guess a little bit too much. You know -- but anyway, it was a hard fight fighting back -- being -- having a name as being a heavy drinker you know. You've got a hard fight to fight back that reputation you know. There's a whole lot of guys that got it and never did get out of it so they just kept on drinking you know. Nobody would hire them. And there's some few yet that guys won't hire because they think they drink too much. You know -- I don't know -- I think if you can drink and control yourself -- but I guess everybody thinks they can control it, but you know -- well so much for that.
